company.name: Persephone Biosciences
company.shortDescription: Persephone Biosciences uses artificial intelligence to rapidly develop microbial based immunotherapies to enable a lifetime without cancer.
company.description:
Persephone Biosciences develops healthcare technology designed to focus on microbial therapeutics for immuno-oncology applications. The company's technology uses artificial intelligence and omics techniques on multiple cancer patient gut microbiome and blood samples to identify microbes needed for normal immune function for population-scale patient data analytics, enabling lab researchers to design microbial drugs that prevent and fight cancer.

Persephone Biosciences was founded in 2017 and is based in San Diego, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Persephone Biosciences is researching compositions for modulating gut microflora populations and the treatment of dysbiosis, as described in 'Compositions for modulating gut microflora populations, treatment of dysbiosis.' The abstract details methods and formulations using combinations of non-pathogenic, live bacteria or bacterial spores, such as probiotics, aimed at controlling, ameliorating, or preventing disease. Their R&D focuses on microbial-based approaches to influence health outcomes.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Persephone Biosciences combines Microbial-Based Cancer Immunotherapies with AI-Enabled Microbial Immunotherapy Discovery Platform.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
